title: Why do cats purr?
examples: Does a cat purr when it is scared?
How does a cat make that rumbling sound?
Can I teach my cat to purr on command?

explain.say: A voice says: Cats make a special sound called purring.

items: It is a cat's unique noise

explain.say: A voice says: Purring actually comes from their chest and throat.
A voice says: It is made by muscles moving very fast together.
A voice says: Sometimes cats purr when they feel very happy and safe.
A voice says: Cats also purr when they are hurt or when they need comfort.
A voice says: If you pet your cat gently, it might start to purr for you.

faq.q: Why do cats purr when they are scared?
faq.a: Cats can purr when they feel scared or stressed. It might be a way to calm themselves down when things feel overwhelming.
asks: Is purring a sign of fear?

faq.q: Is purring only a sign that a cat is happy?
faq.a: No, purring can mean several things. It can show contentment, but it can also mean the cat is healing or feeling secure.

faq.q: How loud can a cat purr?
faq.a: A cat's purr is a low, vibrating sound. It is more felt than it is heard, like a gentle motor running.
asks: How do you hear the purr?

faq.a: No, some cats do not purr very often. It is a natural ability that not every cat uses.
asks: Is purring normal for all cats?

faq.q: Can I make my cat purr?
faq.a: You can try petting your cat gently in a way it likes. If it feels safe, it might start to purr for you.
asks: How do I make a cat purr?
What works to get a cat to purr?

facts: Purring is a vibration that comes from the cat's chest.
Cats use purring to communicate feelings of safety.
The frequency of the purr can sometimes help with healing bones.

quiz.say: A cat is curled up on a soft blanket and making a low rumble. What is the cat doing?
quiz.why: The low, rumbling sound is the definition of purring.

wrong.0: Hissing is a warning sound, usually when the cat feels threatened.
wrong.1: Growling is a deep sound that usually means the cat is angry or warning you.
wrong.3: Meowing is a higher pitched vocalization used for talking to people.

quiz.say: If a cat is purring while you are petting it, what does this mostly show?
quiz.why: Purring when someone pets you shows the cat feels safe and happy with you.

wrong.0: Pain might make a cat whine, but purring is usually positive.
wrong.2: Hunger usually makes a cat meow or rub against things.
wrong.3: Fear usually makes a cat hide or make a different sound.

quiz.say: A cat purrs when it is hurt. This shows that purring can also mean:
quiz.show: Purring can mean more than just happy.
quiz.why: The text taught that purring can help a cat feel better when it is hurt.

wrong.0: Play is shown by pouncing or chasing toys.
wrong.1: Warning is usually done by hissing or swatting.
wrong.3: Anger is usually shown by flattened ears or hissing.
